source.attribution: Contains data supplied by UK Centre for Ecology & Hydrology.

assumptions: Opposite side is mirrored for an explicitly bilateral schematic, not measured.
Midline symmetry removes small local Y offsets.
An elliptical hourglass is a schematic centrum; no claim to joint cup depth, wall thickness or bone volume.
Arch paths and display stroke radii are authored; preserved opening is topological, not a measured canal cross-section.
LM9/10 locate the attachment only; missing ribs and haemal processes are not extrapolated.
Haiyu bending is a design mapping, not inferred fish movement.

sparse_fit.choice: Fixed four sample knots, not optimized and not biological region boundaries.

registration.assessment: All v8 raw landmarks lie on its STL surface to the coordinate-export precision. Smooth 11-row order and adjacent gaps support a contiguous local segment, but authors did not explicitly document a shared-frame contract for every row. No whole-fish registration is asserted.
